title: Symptom-Free Day Streak
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=condition:symptom
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(severity) as worst by _time
| eval symptom_free=if(worst=0,1,0)
| streamstats reset_after="(symptom_free=0)" sum(symptom_free) as streak
| sort - _time
description: Counts your current run of consecutive days with no symptoms so progress is visible and encouraging.
value: A visible good-day streak is powerful motivation and a simple summary of how well the condition is being controlled.
implementation: Ingest daily symptom scores into `index=personal`; compute the current symptom-free streak.
visualization: Single-value panel of the current symptom-free-day streak.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many days in a row you have felt well, turning good spells into a streak worth protecting.
